nom: CHANEL UV ESSENTIEL Complete UV Protection Sunscreen Antioxidant Broad Spectrum SPF 50

segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the sunscreen works well as a hydrating product on her skin type.
segments.sensitive: A reviewer with sensitive/combination skin reports the product works amazing on her skin and does not sting or irritate the eyes.
segments.combination: The same sensitive/combination-skin reviewer reports good results and no irritation with this sunscreen.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, works under makeup
High price for amount of product

extraits.texte: Love this sunscreen! It does have a fragrance but i don't find it too strong. It is on the shiny side-takes maybe 10 mins to fully set once applied to the skin. It is on the pricy side but is very hydrating &spreads easy!
Great product, doesn't leave oily residue, lightweught formula. Perfect for under makeup. Does not irritate my eyes and smells great. Very similar yo European formula.

My all time favorite sunscreen!!! I would repurchase again & again ✨ Leaves a beautiful glow and plumpness on my skin feels just like a moisturizer. The high SPF 50 is a plus! Glides on beautifully and doesn't leave a white cast. A little goes a long way. Works amazing with my sensitive / combo skin. I put my friend on to this sunscreen and she has dry skin and it works wonders for her too. I would say it works amazing for all skin types. Chanel is definitely one of my go to for skincare/makeup 🥰💞

It lasted me a few months and I'm using it all up!! So good just bummer that it's expensive for a little, but at least it really is so good!

reserve: The sample is small (10 reviews, mostly 5-star) and few reviewers specify a skin type or concern in detail, so segment- and concern-level conclusions rest on very limited evidence.
